capabilities: Plan weekly meals by dragging recipes onto days
Scale recipe servings to household members and guests
Track pantry stock and lower it when a meal is marked eaten
Build shopping lists per trip, sorted by shop shelf order
Run step-by-step cook mode with checkboxes and timers
disambiguation: Not just a pantry inventory: it plans weekly meals and builds shopping lists from them.
extras: Everything is stored as plain Markdown notes with no accounts, servers or network requests; notes carry a format number, and the README warns to update the plugin on every device before planning two trips at once because older builds decide shopping lists differently.
problem: Recipes and plans can live in notes, but nothing scales servings to the people eating, tracks what is in the house, or turns a week of meals into a sorted shopping list.
summary: Meal planner that scales recipes to who is eating, tracks pantry stock and turns weekly plans into shop-sorted grocery lists.
